Bundesliga, La Liga, Primeira Liga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Premier League, Championship, MLS, Belgian Pro League, Eredivisie or Super Lig, by the league table in src/lib/clubManager.ts. That is the Austrian Bundesliga, Swiss Super League, Saudi Pro League, Scottish Premiership, Super League Greece, SuperSport HNL, Danish Superliga and the Brasileirao (Liga MX has no pending row left).
method: Read with WebFetch only on 2026-10-03 (the session's web search budget was spent, so pages were reached by their own navigation, by ESPN's public search endpoint and by the Livesport search endpoint behind Soccerway). Family A is the club's own squad page or the league's own page (bundesliga.at, hnl.hr, the clubs' sites). Family B is an independent publisher on another host: ESPN's 2026-27 squad and player pages and Soccerway's player pages, which count as two publishers. A row leaves pending when an A and a B source agree on the day read. Where the official page for the club a verdict names could not be read (many club sites render their squad by script, some answered 403, 404 or 522), the row was settled only when ESPN and Soccerway both agree with dated 2026-27 evidence (league appearances or a dated transfer), the precedent of the 2026-10-02 Brazil pass, and the row carries officialPageRead false so the fold can hold it back if the stricter rule is wanted. A row resting on one publisher stays pending. Namesakes are told apart by the birth date or age the sources print against the baked age in src/data/clubManagerRosters.ts (a 2025 row, so one year younger). Same row shapes as the ledger: confirmedStill rows carry club, movedTo rows carry from, to and realClub, removedClubNotModelled rows carry from and realClub, notCurrent rows carry from and why, pending rows carry club, checkedOn and the reason.
